title: Book Two · Chapter 185: A Notice for Everyone
story:
A notice goes up near the school gate before the new term. Ronan sees it on his way to return a holiday book. He stops because the heading says MATERIALS TRIAL.

Next term, three students can help check materials in the reading room. They will prepare pages for other pupils to use.

The work will last four weeks, one afternoon each week. That is the trial period.

Anyone at the school can apply. They do not need to be on the old shortlist.

Everyone must do a new paper task and answer questions aloud. Those new results will decide who gets the three trial places.

At the bottom, a clear line explains the limit. The trial ends after four weeks. It does not give anyone a full group place. Leo and Mei keep their two places this school year.

Ronan reads the page twice. He feels hopeful at first. Then he starts to worry. Perhaps Miss Wu put this up because of his mistake. Perhaps everyone will think it is a quiet way to let him back in.

Two girls stop beside him. One reads the afternoon time and says it does not fit her music practice. The other takes a small application sheet.

“I can do it,” she says. “Will you ask me questions from the samples?”

They leave together. Neither looks at Ronan.

He takes one application sheet too. Everyone gets the same sheet. It asks for his name and his free time. He also needs to agree to the trial rules.

Inside the reading room, Miss Wu takes his returned book.

“I saw the new notice,” he says.

“Read the times before you apply. The four afternoons are fixed.”

“Is this because of the record?”

She shakes her head. “We need to try a short period of materials work next term. The notice is for everyone. You can apply under the same rules.”

“Would I still need both new tasks?”

“Yes.”

He looks at the sheet in his hand. He will get no extra mark because he corrected the record. But he can apply even with only three good practice results.

At home, he puts the application on the kitchen table. Mum reads the four dates. Dad looks at the afternoon times.

“I need to check my school work too,” Ronan says.

“Good,” Mum says. “We can look after dinner.”

He wants to write his name immediately. Instead, he takes out his other school notes and checks them beside the dates.

After dinner, they check every date. Ronan is free on all four afternoons. Mum asks him to explain the four-week limit. He explains it in his own words.

Then he writes his name on the sheet. It is an application. It promises no place yet. He puts it in his bag to return at the start of the new term.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

trial place＝试做名额；apply＝申请；aloud＝出声地；fixed＝固定的。

## 理解问题

1. 这次公开短期试做和原来的两个正式席位有什么区别？
2. Ronan申请时享有什么相同机会，又必须完成什么相同要求？

## 读句子

**It promises no place yet.**

拆开看：It / promises / no place yet.

它／此时不保证／任何名额。
